commit.message:
fix(clang-tidy): justify external linkage in compiler warnings fixture (#1295)

Resolves the 14 remaining `misc-use-internal-linkage` alerts, all in
`quality/compiler_warnings/test/no_warnings/clean.cpp`, with a justified
`NOLINTBEGIN/END`.

The file is a compile-only false-positive fixture whose helpers are
intentionally unused. Moving them to an anonymous namespace would
trigger `-Wunused-function`, the very warning the fixture asserts is
absent (and would fail with `-Werror`). Keeping external linkage
preserves the test's meaning.

commit.message:
fix(clang-tidy): justify signed bitwise operations on POSIX flags

The operands are non-negative POSIX constants (O_NONBLOCK, POLLIN, POLLOUT)
and the fcntl/pollfd APIs are int-based. Casting to unsigned and back
changes no bits and adds no safety while obscuring the intent, so suppress
hicpp-signed-bitwise with a justification instead.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
fix(clang-tidy): justify signed bitwise operations on POSIX flags (#1304)

Suppresses the 4 `hicpp-signed-bitwise` alerts
(`unix_domain_engine.cpp`, `bidirectional_transport.cpp`,
`flock_test.cpp`) with justified `NOLINTNEXTLINE`.

The operands are non-negative POSIX constants (`O_NONBLOCK`, `POLLIN`,
`POLLOUT`) and `fcntl`/`pollfd` are int-based APIs. Casting to unsigned
and back changes no bits and adds no safety, while obscuring the intent.
clang-tidy aspect shows no remaining `signed-bitwise` warnings;
`--config=ci` build passes.
